name: user_county_id
description: Five-digit FIPS code of the user's US county
observations: All rows are US-US pairs, so the source's constant country columns are dropped

name: friend_county_id
description: Five-digit FIPS code of the friend's US county

name: scaled_sci
description: Scaled Social Connectedness Index between the user county and the friend county, proportional to the probability that a Facebook user in the first is friends with a Facebook user in the second
observations: Dimensionless relative index: SCI(i,j) = friendships(i,j) / (users(i) x users(j)), rescaled by Meta to lie between 1 and 1,000,000,000 within each source file. Ratios are comparable within a table (and within a level), not across tables. Symmetric: SCI(i,j) = SCI(j,i)
